🆕 NEW RELEASE: Fall Out Boy share Doomsday Generation with Walter Schreifels

Fall Out Boy released a second new single, "Doomsday Generation (Slacker for the Ages)", on 13 November 2026, only days after "ACES". It features Walter Schreifels of Quicksand and Gorilla Biscuits. No album or EP has been confirmed around the song yet.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Pennywise and Descendents announce 2027 Reconstruction Tour

Pennywise and Descendents share the bill again on the Reconstruction Tour through Europe and the UK in May 2027. End It and DFL support, and Haywire join for the UK and Spain dates. Germany gets two stops, in Wiesbaden and Oberhausen.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Hayley Williams to curate and headline Outbreak Festival 2027

Hayley Williams is set as curator and headliner of Outbreak Festival 2027, with The Hayley Williams Show on both nights. Citizen have also been added to the bill. The festival takes place in Manchester on 19 and 20 June 2027.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Turnover announce biggest UK and Europe headline tour yet

Turnover have booked what they call their biggest UK and European headline run so far, set for March 2027. In Germany the band plays Berlin on 9 March and Cologne on 10 March, and the tour closes with two London shows on 19 and 20 March.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Yonaka announce six German club shows for early 2027

Yonaka have announced six club shows in Germany between 6 February and 3 March 2027. The stops are Frankfurt, Düsseldorf, Hannover, Bremen, Leipzig and Nuremberg.
